name: Krishna Sai Kannan
paragraphs: I'm 16 and have grown up around the world of marketing. My father works in the field, and I became fascinated by it early on. I've published a research paper, been selected for a national-level finance Olympiad, and completed an internship with a company in the United States.
Outside academics, I enjoy sport and compete at state level. I also play guitar and explore other arts, including sculpting. I'm looking forward to working with you.

name: Prithvik T Hanson
paragraphs: I'm a student drawn to management, strategy, and why people make the choices they do. I'm especially interested in consumer psychology, behavioral economics, decision-making, marketing strategy, and market positioning.

A short-term internship with Capitaire gave me a chance to observe business operations and professional decision-making. I also co-run a small marketing firm with friends, which gives me hands-on experience with branding, audiences, and strategy for clients.
Outside business, I play guitar and enjoy creative pursuits. I'm interested in how psychology, strategy, and creativity can come together to build better businesses.

name: Hannah Ann Leejo
paragraphs: I enjoy taking initiative, sharing ideas, and exploring opportunities beyond the classroom. I've served as my school's Assistant School Leader and taken part in public speaking, compering, and other school activities.

I enjoy writing, communicating, organising, and bringing ideas to life. Curious and creative, I'm especially interested in science, technology, and discovering new fields. I value meaningful experiences and perspectives that challenge me to grow, and I make the most of each opportunity as I continue exploring my strengths.

name: Neha Maria Tedy
paragraphs: I'm a Class 11 student who is ambitious, creative, and open-minded. Editing and videography are especially important to me because visual storytelling can turn ordinary moments into something memorable. I enjoy experimenting with transitions, visual effects, colour grading, composition, and new editing techniques.

Travel inspires me too. I love discovering unfamiliar places, experiencing different cultures, and finding the stories each place has to tell. I hope to keep learning, refining my creative skills, and taking on opportunities that help me build an identity of my own.
